the_information_bottleneck_reframe.authority: CEO Round 160: 'Find an important clinical failure mode where the current state of the art is structurally incapable of obtaining the information needed to solve it. Then invent around the information bottleneck, not the existing product.'

application.C1_space: Search for latent states NOT observable from pressure: local hydraulic resistance, catheter-wall deformation, valve hysteresis, flow redistribution, partial obstruction geometry, tissue-interface state
application.C3_space: Move upstream/downstream from concentration-based control: therapeutic response from CSF dynamics, delivery failure detection, tissue exposure inference, causal physiological state targeting
application.C5_space: Search for pre-failure observables: device deformation, force-displacement hysteresis, local flow redistribution, microfragment migration, transient pressure signatures, clot-device coupling change, fracture-energy release, acoustic/mechanical signatures

the_information_bottleneck_reframe.why_this_is_stronger: Information bottlenecks create STRUCTURAL moats. If the incumbent cannot observe the information, they cannot replicate the solution without a fundamentally different sensor/modality.

honest_assessment.what_round_160_accomplished: Round 160 corrected the false belief that C2-Y, C3-X, and C5-X are clean white spaces. The CEO's external patent search revealed that the market has already moved into these spaces in 2025-2026. This is a major epistemic correction.
honest_assessment.what_this_means: The system has ZERO viable World-Class candidates. All three 'promising' successors (C2-Y, C3-X, C5-X) are prior-art threatened. The discovery queue (C1-X, C1-Y, C2-X, C5-Y) has NOT been novelty-searched. The system must go back to Stage 0 and search deeper.
honest_assessment.is_this_bad_news: NO — this is GOOD news. It is better to know that the white spaces are not white than to falsely believe we have three inventions. The system has avoided epistemic inflation. The discovery engine is now novelty-first, which will produce FEWER claims, STRONGER claims.
honest_assessment.the_standard_going_forward: When asked to 'find World-Class inventions,' the system will interpret this as: 'Find technically important white spaces that survive the strongest currently discoverable patent, scientific, competitor, and obviousness attack — and then prove the surviving mechanism in independent virtual worlds.' NOT: 'Generate clever ideas.'
